title: Is a zero the same as a blank when finding a mean?
description: A player's runs include a zero and a match not played. The video shows why the zero counts as a match and the blank does not. Keeko doubts the matches and shares the total among seven.
teaching_notes: One idea: a zero is a value that counts as an observation, while a blank is no value and is left out of the count. Watch for students who divide by the number of rows instead of the number of values.

source: A player scores 57, 13, 0, 84, no value, 51, 27 in a series
video_script.why: The child has averaged lists of numbers and now meets a list where one entry is zero and one is missing.
video_script.substitution: The book's own seven match series, with match five not played.
video_script.wrong_answer: thirty three point one four runs
video_script.wrong_move: Divides the total of 232 by seven, counting the match that was not played as one more match.
video_script.payoff_line: The player scored about thirty eight point six seven runs per match.

final_answer.spoken: thirty eight point six seven runs per match

maths_rules: matches played: 7 - 1 = 6 (the 0 is a played match; the blank is not)
video_script.design: One idea: zero is a value, blank is not. Seven match cards sit in the anchor; the zero card stays lit, the blank card fades out of the count.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>This is a question from your book about a player in a series of seven matches.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The runs in the first four matches were fifty seven, thirteen, zero and eighty four.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Match five was not played, so its card is blank.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>In the last two matches the player scored fifty one and twenty seven.
<bookmark mark='m6'/>We want the mean runs per match.
<bookmark mark='m7'/>How many matches should the total be shared among?

marks.m1: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the zero card lit and labelled played, scored nothing; the blank card faded and labelled not played, no value

marks.m2: the blank card fades with the label not played, no value

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A zero is a real value, because the player played and scored nothing.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A blank means there is no value at all, because that match was never played.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A played match is counted, and a match not played is left out.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Given, the runs of a player in seven matches.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Match five was not played.

beats.on_screen: To find: mean runs per match

marks.m1: the words mean runs per match are written

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to find the mean runs per match.

marks.m1: the six played cards are counted one by one
marks.m2: the blank card is crossed out of the count

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, count the matches that were played.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The zero match was played, so it counts, and the blank match was not played.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That leaves six matches.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, add the runs of the six matches.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Fifty seven plus thirteen plus zero plus eighty four gives one hundred and fifty four.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Adding fifty one and twenty seven gives two hundred and thirty two in all.

marks.m1: six equal boxes appear under the total

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, share the total equally among the six matches played.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That is two hundred and thirty two shared by six.

marks.m2: the words to two decimal places appear

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The player scored about thirty eight point six seven runs per match.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That is the mean to two decimal places, with the zero counted and the blank left out.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: 232 ÷ 7 ≈ 33.14 crossed out; the blank card fades
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko thinks the mean is about thirty three point one four runs. Keeko shared the total among seven matches.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the player did not play one match, so there is no score to share for it.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A match not played is not counted, so we share among six.
